name: Channel
description: TauSync named-stream identifiers. Both PC and Android must call tau.connect() with the exact same string — define it here once and generate both sides.

members.name: DEVICE_INFO
members.description: Stream for exchanging static device metadata (name, model, OS version).

members.name: BATTERY
members.description: Stream for real-time battery level and charging-state updates.

members.name: STORAGE
members.description: Stream for storage usage statistics (total, used, free).

members.name: TOOLS
members.description: Stream for syncing the available tools/actions list.
